005package org.wpilib.system;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.HALUtil;
008
009/** Runtime type. */
010public enum RuntimeType {
011  /** Systemcore runtime. */
012  SYSTEMCORE(HALUtil.RUNTIME_SYSTEMCORE),
013  /** Simulation runtime. */
014  SIMULATION(HALUtil.RUNTIME_SIMULATION);
015
016  /** RuntimeType value. */
017  public final int value;
018
019  RuntimeType(int value) {
020    this.value = value;
021  }
022
023  /**
024   * Construct a runtime type from an int value.
025   *
026   * @param type Runtime type as int
027   * @return Matching runtime type
028   */
029  public static RuntimeType getValue(int type) {
030    if (type == HALUtil.RUNTIME_SYSTEMCORE) {
031      return RuntimeType.SYSTEMCORE;
032    } else {
033      return RuntimeType.SIMULATION;
034    }
035  }
036}
